_readme: Site-wide facts. Edit here, then run: python3 _build/build.py. Lists marked A-Z are checked by the build (cities, more). site_url = the ONE canonical base (no trailing slash): canonicals, og:url, sitemap and schema @id all derive from it; switch it when the domain is set. nav = the desktop header links (Maz 10-15: Services, Our jobs, About, Contact; home_href = same-page anchor on the homepage) and the first phone-menu links; menu_more = the rest of the phone menu (Our process, then Blog, FAQ, Service areas); more = the footer links, A-Z. form.endpoint empty = the quote sheet falls back to call/text (never a 405). email stays empty until a working inbox is confirmed. phone.texts = also offer "Text" (off until confirmed). home_jobs = the homepage 2x2 (Bathroom 1 stands in for Kitchen 1 while K1 is unpublished). cities[].intro / nearby / meta_description = city page copy (copy deck §9); city pages are noindex, follow and stay out of the sitemap (Maz 10-15).
